name: Shirai Karen
source: Lived in the same city as the protagonist and until the 2nd grade of elementary school. They often spent time together and she is one year younger than he is. Her cute face, nearly translucent skin and refined way of speaking are able to get the protagonist's heart racing. She also has a bit of teasing streak.
